title: FitTracker Pro
problem_statement: People want to be healthier but struggle to stay motivated. There are many fitness apps on the market but they don't fully meet user needs. FitTracker Pro will help users achieve their fitness goals through a comprehensive and engaging mobile experience.
target_users: People who want to get fit
Anyone who wants to track their workouts and progress
user_stories: As a user, I want to track my workouts so that I can see my progress
As a user, I want to set fitness goals so that I stay motivated
As a user, I want to see my statistics so that I know how I'm doing
As a premium user, I want access to advanced features so that I can get more value from the app
acceptance_criteria: The app should be easy to use and intuitive
Users should be able to track different types of workouts
The app should display progress over time in a meaningful way
Performance should be acceptable under normal usage conditions

success_metrics.target: Significant downloads within the first year

risks_open_questions: Competition from existing fitness apps like MyFitnessPal
User retention may be challenging to maintain long-term
out_of_scope: Features not related to fitness tracking
Functionality to be determined in future phases
